en: In this module, it's time for space
complexity.
Now, thus far we focused on runtime, on time
complexity, on the Big O notation for time
complexity. That's what we used thus far in
this course to compare algorithms. And I can
already tell you,
time complexity, so what we used thus far,
typically is the far more important measure
for comparing algorithms.
In interviews, but also in discussions with
colleagues,
you will in 99% of cases talk about the time
complexity.
Nonetheless, we also have another dimension
we can use when we wanna compare or judge
algorithms, and that would be the space
complexity. So in this module, we'll take a
closer look at what space complexity
actually is,
how we can derive it for our algorithms, and
of course, we'll dive into some examples and
judge some of the algorithms we already saw
in this course by their space complexity.
